criteria.extend_existing_packages: Add owner-scoped operations to the existing process, files and codec packages instead of a new package. Reuses established package identities and avoids new-package registration. Owner-mediated variants sit beside direct Bun operations in the same packages, and the dispatch allowlist is the union of the new members.
criteria.single_test_package: Add one new package can.std.test@1 holding every base owner, workspace, process and evidence operation with opaque non-constructible handle types. Each allowed native call is its own catalogue operation, so the inventory is the dispatch allowlist and arbitrary dispatch/eval is unrepresentable. One emitter contribution maps the identities to $canTest targets built by the two new factories (owner.ts, transport.ts). Forged handles fail table lookup; stale handles fail liveness lookup.
criteria.split_owner_test_packages: Add can.std.owner@1 for grant identity and transport primitives plus can.std.test@1 for workspace, process and evidence operations. Separates identity/transport from domain operations into two reserved packages, two runtime factories and two emitter contributions.

binding_shape.instructions: Which binding shape best satisfies the acceptance terms with the least mechanism while keeping the dispatch vocabulary closed?
